TEXT:
[FI] The key to a happy marriage is understanding 
each other, or so I believe. Whether if it's our strong 
points or if it's our weak points, everything...

[FI] Not too long after graduating from college, we 
married each other, soon enough, we became a 
family of three.

[FI] I can't say we are wealthy but, we are living like a 
normal family. There's always a ruckus, but it's 
bright, fun and wonderful-

[FI] Hinata and Tamaki are both always kind to me. I 
am truly surrounded by happiness. And one more 
happiness is about to visit our househ-

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...What on earth are you up to?

[FI] I jumped in shock after hearing a voice from 
behind me.

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT: [FI] M-Mom!? Geez, don't scare me like that!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] "Future Diary?"

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT: [FI] Urgh...

[FI] My mom's eyes, who peeked into my notebook, 
started glistening in an instant.

[FI] ...That's... the face of her finding a toy. Whenever Mom 
makes that face, either Dad or I end up in trouble.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Hey Yuri, it's fine for you to daydream, but if you 
get too delusional, you'll end up hurt.

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT:
[FI] Y-You're the only one I don't want to hear that 
from, Mom!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] But, how did you...

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT: [FI] I heard from Aunt Hinata!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] W-What...? Hinata!

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: [FI] What's up, Ruri-nee?

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: [FI] No fighting, you two.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Don't say "what's up". Why did you tell her things 
she didn't need to hear?

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] Ah, about your past with chuunibyou, Ruri-nee? It's 
fine, there's no need to hide it.

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT:
[FI] See, I knew it! Both Mom and Aunt Tamaki were 
like that!

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: [FI] Wha!? I-I'm no longer like that, okay!

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] Oh really~? I don't think you've given it up 
completely.

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: [FI] You're saying that too...

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT:
[FI] Aunt Tamaki, you kept telling me to call you 
"Onee-sama" whenever we meet.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Tamaki, you...

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: [FI] N-No, it's nothing like that...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'm home!

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: [FI] H-Hey, your Dad's home.

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT: [FI] Geez, don't dodge the issue.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Huh? What happened?

SPEAKER: SPK_TAMAKI
TEXT: [FI] Wawah, it's nothing!

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] Oh, we were just talking about how reliable 
Yuri-chan has become.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ?  What was it all about?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Welcome home, Kyousuke.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'm home, Ruri.

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT:
[FI] And there's the "I'm home" kiss... Oh boy, keeping 
things hot like always~!

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT:
[FI] This happens every time but, just looking makes 
me embarrassed...

[FI] At least refrain yourselves when we have guests 
over...? It's impossible though, they're too 
lovey-dovey.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Hey, don't just stand there, carry my luggage!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, sorry.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Oh my, what a rare sight.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[FI] I just happened to be in the neighborhood, visiting 
my parents. You look well.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Thank you.

[FI] Geh, Aunt Kirino... I'm a bit poor at handling this 
person. If I don't call her Onee-chan, she gets all 
mad. Sometimes her eyes get all scary too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Ah, Yuri-chan! You've gotten bigger!

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT: [FI] Welcome, Kirino......onee-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Man, Yuri-chan's way too cute~!

[FI] Aunt Kirino pushed her luggage onto Dad, then she 
energetically hugged me!
[FI] T-This is why I don't like her at all!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...Huh? What's this notebook?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It looks like Yuri was thinking about her ideal family.

[FI] Somehow I escaped Aunt Kirino's demonic hands, I 
retreat towards Dad but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] You mean, you found a person you like, Yuri!? Dad 
won't approve of this!

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT: [FI] Dad, you sound just like grandpa...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] D-Do I...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Hehe.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Ah, but there's nothing written in here about me.

[FI] Aunt Kirino raised her voice sadly after reading my 
notebook without asking me.

[FI] Even if you say that... it's supposed to be an image 
of my future family...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Yuri-chan's my wife, and yet...

SPEAKER: SPK_HINATA
TEXT: [FI] Kirino-san's energetic like always.

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT:
[FI] Mo~m. I'm not confident at all that I can grow up 
properly in this environment.

[FI] Honestly, there are plenty of bad examples here 
that could cause real harm...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Hehe.

[FI] Mom happily laughs as I say that... No, this isn't a 
laughing matter... okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] But you know, Yuri will be an older sister soon, so 
it'll be a handful if we don't get it together.

[FI] As Mom said that, she gently smiled while rubbing 
her stomach.

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT: [FI] No way!? I'm going to be an older sister?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Yes. Here Yuri, come over?

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT: [FI] Yeah!

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT: [FI] Hey, is it going to be a boy? Or maybe it's a girl?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Which would you prefer, Yuri?

SPEAKER: SPK_YURI
TEXT: [FI] Well I think-

[FI] I wonder? Brother or sister, I'll probably be happy. 
But if I had to pick one-

[FI] As they watched me worrying over this choice... 
Dad and Mom gently smiled.
